title: Implement finite two-tape control for nested parking frames
head: 1662dda699d9ea57b3fb13a23873b087d765149f
body:
PR2574's nested invocation wrapper uses host-language packet extents and frame floors while leaving its physical controller open. This package implements its matched-record parking subinterface with a fixed two-tape, ten-state, 490-entry transition table. Physical record/frame delimiters and head displacements supply the boundaries; every action depends only on the finite state and scanned symbols.

A written induction proves exact packet order, cleanup, rewound heads and opaque ancestor preservation for every finite packet width and well-bracketed nested command sequence, including empty and unequal packets. PUSH costs `2n+3` transitions and POP `3n+4`; all reads, writes, moves and marker storage are charged explicitly. For total matched packet volume V, r packet pairs and d frame pairs, the complete parking ledger is `5V+7r+3d` steps, `10V+14r+6d` reads, `4V+4r+2d` writes and `8V+8r+2d` moves.

The sparse simulator and a separate dense interpreter agree on all 2,047 packets through width 10, 21 translated cases through 16,384 bits, and nested frames through depth 129. Nine control groups cover boundary rejection, occupied output cells before writes, actual transition faults and incomplete tables. Registered CPython 3.12.7 primary and both Git-free/integrity test groups pass. A separate agent reviewed the complete proof and code and independently replayed optimized CPython 3.12.14 with no blocking finding.

Scope: matched whole packets only, with trusted well-bracketed caller commands. This does not expose arbitrary partial-size pops, authenticate ownership against hostile commands, allocate all logical caller tapes or implement the full dispatcher/supplier. Packet production and consumption remain charged caller work outside this table. No locally reversible transition-system claim, selected cold replay, new profile or kappa is made.

Source PR2574 at `07d75bfc2e13f0c17d84a3788885affc4d712dc1` is pinned unchanged, including proof, matching caller, stream primitives and notice; retained executables are reference text and never executed. Credit its PR2534/2483/2250/2287 lineage. Canonical main was refreshed unchanged at `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; priority revision 4, picker seed `ec3ae3aa2e614be2c97851bf5f8ff527`, required supplier-boundary first command passed. TASK.json records scope change and overlap limits: complete 798-PR/1,252-Discussion cache plus fresh source-head and 100 recently updated PR-body checks at 16:28 UTC. Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate agent review; no independent human review is claimed.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
